# ywc-agent-toolkit

> A distribution toolkit published on GitHub. Claude Code: 51 skills and 14 agents. Codex: 54 skills and 10 agents.

The guidebook pages below are plain Markdown, listed in reading order. To set the toolkit up and run it, read [03. Prerequisites and installation](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/15-prerequisites-installation.md) first, then [04. Ship your first feature in 5 minutes](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/03-quickstart.md), then the page that matches the task. Each page also exists in ko, ja, zh and es: replace `/en/` in the URL. The HTML version of a page is the same URL with `.md` replaced by `/`.

## Guidebook

- [01. Introduction](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/01-introduction.md): This repository defines around 30 Skills with the ywc-* prefix under claude-code/skills/, plus several dedicated Agents under claude-code/agents/.
- [02. Core concepts](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/02-core-concepts.md): Once you understand the terms and concepts on this page, you can apply the examples from every other guide page directly.
- [03. Prerequisites and installation](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/15-prerequisites-installation.md): To use ywc-* Skills reliably, a few tools need to be in place beforehand.
- [04. Ship your first feature in 5 minutes](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/03-quickstart.md): This page is your first hands-on exercise: follow one small bug fix from the idea stage to merge.
- [05. Handling a small change (general cycle - small)](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/04-general-cycle-small.md): When ywc-plan judges a request as Small, it automatically enters this path.
- [06. Handling work split into multiple Tasks (general cycle - medium/large)](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/05-general-cycle-medium-large.md): If any of the following applies, ywc-plan routes to this path.
- [07. Finish automatically from one goal (ywc-agentic)](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/06-agentic-autonomous-loop.md): Goal -> [Plan -> Execute -> Evaluate -> Repeat] -> Result
- [08. Skill combination recipes](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/19-skill-combination-recipes.md): The other pages explain one flow or one Skill at a time.
- [09. Starting a new Project](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/07-starting-a-new-project.md): Use this when there is no Git repository yet, or when the repository exists but is essentially a blank slate with little code.
- [10. Entering an existing Repo for the first time](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/08-onboarding-existing-repo.md): Use this when you first enter an unfamiliar repository that already has code and need to understand "what this codebase looks like." Conversely, if you are desi…
- [11. Writing and running Tests](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/09-testing-guide.md): Use this after feature implementation is done and you need to verify that it really works as intended.
- [12. E2E Test automation strategy](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/10-e2e-test-strategy.md): Use ywc-e2e-test-strategy when the project does not yet have Playwright-based E2E tests, or when existing coverage is scattered and it is unclear "which flow sh…
- [13. Reviewing and improving design](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/11-design-review.md): The two Skills answer different questions.
- [14. Managing Code Structure and Maintainability](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/16-code-structure-and-maintainability.md): Both Skills start from the same symptom — "the code is bad" — but answer different questions.
- [15. Debugging and incident postmortems](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/12-debugging-and-incident-postmortem.md): The two Skills answer different questions.
- [16. Managing Cloud Infrastructure](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/17-infrastructure-and-cloud.md): All four Skills cover one continuous lifecycle — designing, authoring, reviewing, and improving cloud infrastructure — but each answers a different question.
- [17. Implementing Authentication](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/18-authentication-implementation.md): Use ywc-auth-implement when a project needs a new authentication feature — sign-in/sign-up, OAuth, MFA, session handling, password reset, account deletion, or a…
- [18. Executor / Code-gen Prompt patterns](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/13-executor-and-codegen-patterns.md): Without --aggregate-pr (default behavior): each Task gets its own feature branch and PR.
- [19. Full Skill Reference](https://yongwoon.github.io/ywc-agent-toolkit-lp/en/guidebook/14-skill-reference.md): This page groups the remaining Skills not covered in the previous workflow guides by what you want to do.

## Agents (Codex)

- [ywc-architect](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-architect.toml): Architecture advisor for module boundaries, dependency direction, layering, abstraction trade-offs, API contract shape, and irreversible design decisions.
- [ywc-cloud-engineer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-cloud-engineer.toml): Read-only Infrastructure-as-Code review-mode advisor — the Codex mirror of the read-write cloud engineer worker.
- [ywc-complexity-cleaner](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-complexity-cleaner.toml): Bounded write worker for behavior-preserving complexity reduction in task-owned production code.
- [ywc-go-reviewer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-go-reviewer.toml): Read-only Go reviewer for goroutine lifecycle, channel patterns, interfaces, error wrapping, pointer/value semantics, generics, and lifecycle idioms.
- [ywc-performance-engineer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-performance-engineer.toml): Read-only performance reviewer for backend latency, frontend bundle/render cost, Core Web Vitals, profiler recommendations, and cloud infrastructure cost / FinO…
- [ywc-python-reviewer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-python-reviewer.toml): Read-only Python reviewer for typing, asyncio, framework idioms, GIL implications, lifecycle correctness, and strict tooling baselines.
- [ywc-root-cause-analyst](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-root-cause-analyst.toml): Read-only root-cause analyst for defects, failed tests, incidents, 5 Whys, hypothesis ranking, and architecture-vs-surgical-fix gates.
- [ywc-security-engineer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-security-engineer.toml): Read-only static security reviewer for OWASP Top 10 analysis, bounded threat modeling, secret or PII scans, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) misconfiguration …
- [ywc-test-hardener](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-test-hardener.toml): Bounded write worker for assertion and fixture hardening against task-owned mutation survivors.
- [ywc-typescript-reviewer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-typescript-reviewer.toml): Read-only TypeScript and JavaScript reviewer for type-system depth, async correctness, framework idioms, strictness, and module surface risks.
